    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    try {
    val request = mapper.readValue("{\"model\":\"dall-e-3\",\"n\":1,\"prompt\":\"\",\"size\":\"1024x1024\"}", CreateImageRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.imageGenerate(request)
    } catch (error: Exception) {
        System.err.println("${error::class.simpleName}: ${error.message}")

}
